title: 云计算和SaaS行业结构性变化信号
core_insight: AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud和Microsoft Azure在技术、基础设施和应用层面持续推动云计算和SaaS的发展，展现出强大的创新能力和市场影响力。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出MicroVMs，实现了更高级别的隔离沙盒，增强了Serverless计算能力。Google Cloud发布关于Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform的13个demo，Azure推出Brain AI系统，火山引擎发布ByteHouse云数仓 AWS Certificate Manager支持ACME协议，实现自动化的公钥证书颁发和更新。Google Cloud发布关于BigQuery的column-level安全性和IAM数据治理标签的文章，Azure推出外部密钥管理，Cloudflare推出Workers Cache AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs 13 hands-on demos to build on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Meet Brain: The AI system behind Azure reliability 从 ClickHouse 到 ByteHouse：实时数据分析场景下的优化实践 Automate public TLS certificate issuance with ACME support in AWS Certificate Manager Level Up Your Column-level Security: Using IAM Data Governance Tags in BigQuery
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出新一代Graviton5处理器，提高了计算性能和效率。Azure推出新区域，火山引擎扩展云产品 AWS CloudFormation Express模式加速了基础设施部署，提高了开发效率。Cloudflare推出新型计算服务 Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available Accelerate your infrastructure deployments by up to 4x with AWS CloudFormation Express mode Azure Databricks delivers proven business value 布局云计算，火山引擎的技术发展之路
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce推出多项AI解决方案，帮助企业实现数字化转型和业务创新。Cloudflare推出AI搜索 Canada Goose利用Salesforce的AI能力，提高了客户满意度和业务效率。Azure推出Chaos Studio 25+ AI Tools For Entrepreneurs: Best Business Management Software How Canada Goose Used AI to Expand Capacity and Create a Revenue-Generating Experience Center Making AI search smarter Proving application resilience on Azure with Chaos Studio
dimension_texts.capital: Databricks达到1880亿美元估值，成为AI领域的领军者。Strella获得1400万美元的Series A融资 Vertu推出高端AI产品，瞄准高端市场和企业客户。Anthropic发布关于Claude的新能力 Neil Rimer预测AI领域的投资将会回归，推动新一轮的创新和增长。Amazon和Chobani采用Strella的AI采访 Databricks hits $188B valuation, extending its run as AI’s favorite second act Vertu wants executives to pay $6,880 for an AI agent — here’s how it actually performs Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research as fast-growing startup raises $14M
